name: Screen
lead: A wall or floor of map frames showing a picture, from `world.screen`; it draws like a canvas and can answer clicks by pixel.

functions.name: on_click
functions.signature: screen.on_click(((player: Player, x: number, y: number, button: "left" | "right") -> ()) | false) → ?
functions.description: Called with the pixel the player points at and the button, when a player clicks the screen. nil or false takes the hook off.

functions.name: view
functions.description: Returns this player's own layer over the screen; only they see it, and the shared picture shows where it is see-through.

title: Screen type
